21500.meaning1: is worthy of the monk's robe
21500.meaningLit: worthy of the brown red robe

examples.text: anikkasāvo kāsāvaṃ, yo vatthaṃ paridahissati, apeto damasaccena, na so kāsāvam'arahati.
yo ca vantakasāvassa, sīlesu susamāhito, upeto damasaccena, sa ve kāsāvam'arahati.
kadā nu'haṃ bhinnapaṭan'dharo muni, kāsāvavattho amamo nirāso, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca tath'eva mohaṃ, hantvā sukhī pavanagato vihassaṃ.

21502.meaning2: name of a country (the capital of which was Benares)

examples.text: yāvatā, bhikkhave, kāsikosalā, yāvatā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ, rājā tattha pasenadi kosalo aggam'akkhāyati.
atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ sannayhitvā rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ abbhuyyāsi yena kāsi.

21503.meaning1: from Kāsi country; Kāsian; made in Kāsi
21503.meaning2: belonging to or made of Kāsi

examples.text: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, mahārāja, tayā gihinā kāmabhoginā puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantena kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhontena mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayantena jātarūparajataṃ sādiyantena, ime vā arahanto, ime vā arahattamaggaṃ samāpannā'ti.
haricandanalitt'aṅgiṃ, kāsik'uttamadhāriniṃ, taṃ maṃ rūpavatiṃ santiṃ, kassa ohāya gacchasi.

dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, mahārāja, tayā gihinā kāmabhoginā puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantena kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhontena mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayantena jātarūparajataṃ sādiyantena, ime vā arahanto, ime vā arahattamaggaṃ samāpannā'ti.
tapanīyakatā'va dhītikā, vicarasi cittalat'eva accharā, kāsikasukhumehi vaggubhi, sobhasī suvasanehi n'ūpame.
kāsikasukhumāni dhāraya, abhiropehi ca mālavaṇṇakaṃ, kañcanamaṇimuttakaṃ bahuṃ, vividhaṃ ābharaṇaṃ karomi te.
ṭhitako'va mātukucchisambhavena kenaci asucinā amakkhito suddho visado kāsikavatthe nikkhittamaṇiratanaṃ viya jotayanto mātukucchito nikkhami.

tam'enaṃ bhikkhū evam'āhaṃsu, appasaddā āyasmanto hotha, thero bhikkhu dhammañ'ca vinayañ'ca bhaṇatī'ti. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kāsikavatth'ūpamā bhavissāma, na potthak'ūpamā'ti. evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban'ti.
yāvatā, bhikkhave, kāsikosalā, yāvatā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ, rājā tattha pasenadi kosalo aggam'akkhāyati.

21509.meaning1: people of Kāsi and Kosala; Kāsians and Kosalans
21509.commentary: (DNa) kāsikosalesū'ti kāsīsu ca kosalesu ca, kāsiraṭṭhe ca kosalaraṭṭhe cā'ti attho.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, piyā te kāsikosalā'ti? evaṃ, mallike, piyā me kāsikosalā.
yāvatā, bhikkhave, kāsikosalā, yāvatā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ, rājā tattha pasenadi kosalo aggam'akkhāyati.
atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto kāsigāmake kumbhakārakule nibbattitvā kumbhakārakammaṃ katvā puttadāraṃ posesi.

21511.meaning1: to cause to drag; to cause to pull

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu n'ālaṃ saṅghamhā vapakāsituṃ [vi + apa + kāsituṃ = vapakāsituṃ].

21512.meaning2: coming from Kāsi (of cloth of fine cotton or muslin; of sandal; of fine quality)

examples.text: assosi kho, ānanda, kikī kāsirājā, kassapo kira bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bārāṇasiṃ anuppatto bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā puṇṇā aṅgārānaṃ vīt'accikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ

21517.meaning2: produced by a sage or poet

examples.text: na mandiyā sayāmi n'āpi kāveyyamatto, atthaṃ samecc'āham'apetasoko, eko vivitte sayan'āsanamhi, sayām'ahaṃ sabbabhūt'ānukampī.
ye pana te sutt'antā kavikatā kāveyyā citt'akkharā cittabyañjanā bāhirakā sāvakabhāsitā, tesu bhaññamānesu sussūsissanti, sotaṃ odahissanti

21520.meaning1: drunk on poetry; intoxicated by verse
21520.commentary: (SNa) udāhu kāveyyamatto'ti udāhu yathā kavi kabbaṃ cintento tena kabbakaraṇena matto sayati, evaṃ sayasi. (THa) kāveyyamattā'ti-ādikā dasa gāthā arahattaṃ patvā attano paṭipattiṃ paccavekkhitvā satthu attano ca guṇe vibhāventena vuttā. tattha kāveyyamattā'ti kāveyyena kabbakaraṇena mattā mānitā sambhāvitā guṇodayaṃ āpannā.

examples.text: na mandiyā sayāmi n'āpi kāveyyamatto, atthaṃ samecc'āham'apetasoko, eko vivitte sayan'āsanamhi, sayām'ahaṃ sabbabhūt'ānukampī.
kāveyyamattā vicarimha pubbe, gāmā gāmaṃ purā puraṃ, athaddasāma sambuddhaṃ, sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ.
n'atthi nissaraṇaṃ loke, kiṃ vivekena kāhasi, bhuñjāhi kāmaratiyo, m'āhu pacch'ānutāpinī.

21522.meaning1: you will make; you will build

examples.text: gahakāraka diṭṭho'si, puna gehaṃ na kāhasi, sabbā te phāsukā bhaggā, gahakūṭaṃ visaṅkhataṃ, visaṅkhāragataṃ cittaṃ, taṇhānaṃ khayamajjhagā.
sace musā na bhaṇasi, sace pāṇaṃ na hiṃsasi, sace adinnaṃ n'ādiyasi, saddahāno amaccharī, kiṃ kāhasi gayaṃ gantvā, udapāno'pi te gayā'ti.

kara'icc'etassa dhātussa sapaccayassa kāh'ādeso hoti vā bhavissantimhi vibhattimhi, ssassa ca niccaṃ lopo hoti. kāhati, kāhiti, kāhasi, kāhisi, kāhāmi, kāhāma. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? karissati, karissanti.
s'āhaṃ nūna ito gantvā, yoniṃ laddhāna mānusiṃ, vadaññū sīlasampannā, kāhāmi kusalaṃ bahuṃ.
imās'āhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvā, kāhāmi kusalaṃ bahuṃ, dānena samacariyāya, saññamena damena ca, sv'āhaṃ tattha gamissāmi, yattha gantvā na socare'ti.

kara'icc'etassa dhātussa sapaccayassa kāh'ādeso hoti vā bhavissantimhi vibhattimhi, ssassa ca niccaṃ lopo hoti. kāhati, kāhiti, kāhasi, kāhisi, kāhāmi, kāhāma. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? karissati, karissanti.

21527.commentary: (DHPa) byanti kāhitī'ti esa bhikkhu tīsu bhavesu uppajjanakaṃ taṇhaṃ vigatantaṃ karissati. (THa) sacchikāhitī'ti… sacchikarissati

examples.text: vitakk'ūpasame ca yo rato, asubhaṃ bhāvayate sadā sato, esa kho byanti kāhiti, esa checchati mārabandhanaṃ.
aho buddhā aho dhammā, aho no satthu sampadā, yattha etādisaṃ dhammaṃ, sāvako sacchikāhiti.

21528.meaning1: they will do; they will make

examples.text: kāmaṃ kāmesu damassu, tāva sunakho'va saṅkhal'ābaddho, kāhinti khu taṃ kāmā, chātā sunakhaṃ'va caṇḍālā.

21529.meaning1: you will make; you will build

examples.text: dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vas'ānuvattako, na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhi'r'atthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.

kara'icc'etassa dhātussa sapaccayassa kāh'ādeso hoti vā bhavissantimhi vibhattimhi, ssassa ca niccaṃ lopo hoti. kāhati, kāhiti, kāhasi, kāhisi, kāhāmi, kāhāma. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? karissati, karissanti.
yadā balākā sucipaṇḍaracchadā, kāḷassa meghassa bhayena tajjitā, palehiti ālayam'ālay'esinī, tadā nadī ajakaraṇī rameti maṃ.
tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate santi jātarūpassa sukhumasahagatā upakkilesā sukhumavālukā kāḷajallikā.

21531.commentary: (MNa) āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā'ti yathā āsītikavalliyā vā kāḷavalliyā vā sandhiṭṭhānesu milāyitvā majjhe unnatunnatāni honti, evaṃ mayhaṃ aṅgapaccaṅgāni hontī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā, evam'ev'assu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya. seyyathā'pi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ, evam'ev'assu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

21532.meaning1: name of Cāpā's husband who left her to become an ascetic; Upaka

examples.text: ehi kāḷa nivattassu, bhuñja kāme yathā pure, ahañ'ca te vasīkatā, ye ca me santi ñātakā.
handa kho dāni bhaddante, kuhiṃ kāḷa gamissasi, katamaṃ gāmanigamaṃ, nagaraṃ rājadhāniyo.

21533.commentary: (VIN 1.4.2.2) kāḷakaṃ nāma dve kāḷakāni, jātiyā kāḷakaṃ vā rajanakāḷakaṃ vā.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
kīdiso, bho purisa, kiṃsuko'ti? so evaṃ vadeyya, kāḷako kho, ambho purisa, kiṃsuko, seyyathā'pi jhāmakhāṇū'ti.

seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ samma'd'eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evam'eva tesaṃ caturāsītipāṇasahassānaṃ tasmiṃ'y'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi, yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti

21537.meaning2: name of a rich man in Sāketa

examples.text: tato me hatthapāde ca, jivhaṃ sotañ'ca maddiya, anūnataṃ me passitvā, kāḷakaṇṇī'ti nindisuṃ.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sākete viharati kāḷak'ārāme. tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, bhikkhavo'ti. bhadante'ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca.

21545.meaning2: name of a mountain in the Himalayas

examples.text: tesu anotattadaho sudassanakūṭaṃ cittakūṭaṃ kāḷakūṭaṃ gandhamādanakūṭaṃ kelāsakūṭan'ti imehi pañcahi pabbatakūṭehi parikkhitto.

21548.commentary: (MNa) kāḷakhemakassā'ti chavivaṇṇena so kāḷo, khemako'ti pan'assa nāmaṃ.

examples.text: addasā kho bhagavā kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāre sambahulāni sen'āsanāni paññattāni. disvāna bhagavato etadahosi, sambahulāni kho kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāre sen'āsanāni paññattāni. sambahulā nu kho idha bhikkhū viharantī'ti.
tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate santi jātarūpassa sukhumasahagatā upakkilesā sukhumavālukā kāḷajallikā.

ālokasandhiparikammāyā'ti vātapānaparikammāya setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭikaṃ.
nissaṭṭhaṃ paṭilabhitvā na kāyikena paribhogena paribhuñjitabbaṃ, na ajjhoharitabbaṃ, padīpe vā kāḷavaṇṇe vā upanetabbaṃ, aññena bhikkhunā kāyikena paribhogena paribhuñjitabbaṃ, na ajjhoharitabbaṃ.

21565.meaning2: treated with black wash, smeared with black plaster

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso kāḷavatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā musalaṃ khandhe āropetvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ, bhante, pāpakammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ mosallaṃ, yena me āyasmanto attamanā honti taṃ karomī'ti.

21569.meaning2: fragrant root; powder made from this root

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ye keci mūlagandhā kāḷ'ānusārigandho tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, aniccasaññā … sabbaṃ asmimānaṃ samūhanati.

21571.meaning1: fragrant root; powder made from this root
21571.meaning2: fragrant root; powder made from this root

21580.commentary: (ANa) kāḷigodhāya putto'ti kāḷavaṇṇā sā devī, godhā'ti pan'assā nāmaṃ. tasmā kāḷigodhā'ti vuccati, tassā putto'ti attho. kasmā pan'āyaṃ uccākulikānaṃ aggo'ti vutto, kiṃ tato uccākulikatarā n'atthī'ti? āma n'atthi. tassa hi mātā sākiyānīnaṃ antare vayena sabbajeṭṭhikā, so'y'eva ca sākiyakule sampattaṃ rajjaṃ pahāya pabbajito. tasmā uccākulikānaṃ aggo'ti vutto. apica pubbapatthan'ānubhāvena c'esa anupaṭipāṭiyā pañca jātisatāni rājakule nibbattitvā rajjaṃ kāresiyeva. iminā'pi kāraṇena uccākulikānaṃ aggo'ti vutto.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uccākulikānaṃ yadidaṃ bhaddiyo kāḷigodhāyaputto.
kāḷimbo nāma, bhante, upāsako nātike kālaṅ'kato, tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti?

21583.meaning1: name of a female slave in Sāvatthī

21584.meaning1: name of Mahāmoggallāna's sister in a previous incarnation

examples.text: bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, pāpima, dūsī nāma māro ahosiṃ, tassa me kāḷī nāma bhaginī. tassā tvaṃ putto. so me tvaṃ bhāgineyyo ahosi. tena kho pana, pāpima, samayena kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.

21587.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk among those who inspire faith in families
21587.commentary: (ANt) udāyī'ti tayo therā udāyī nāma kāḷ'udāyī, lāḷ'udāyī, mahāudāyī'ti, idha kāḷ'udāyī adhippeto'ti āha udāyī'ti kāḷudāyitthero'ti.

examples.text: āyasmā udāyī'ti paṭisambhidāppatto kāḷ'udāyitthero.

21589.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk among those who inspire faith in families
21589.commentary: (ANa) thokaṃ kāḷadhātukattā pana kāḷ'udāyī nāma jāto. so bodhisattena saddhiṃ kumārakīḷaṃ kīḷanto vuddhiṃ agamāsi. (THa) ath'assa nāmaggahaṇadivase sakalanagarassa udaggacittadivase jātattā udāyī'tv'eva nāmaṃ akaṃsu, thokaṃ kāḷadhātukattā pana kāḷ'udāyī'ti paññāyittha. so bodhisattena saddhiṃ kumārakīḷaṃ kīḷanto vuddhiṃ agamāsi.
21589.notes: Theragāthā verses 527-536 (TH10.1, TH233) are attributed to him.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kulappasādakānaṃ yadidaṃ kāḷ'udāyī.

21590.meaning1: name of two privately awakened Buddhas; Kāḷa and Upakāḷa

examples.text: kāḷ'ūpakāḷā vijito jito ca, aṅgo ca paṅgo ca guttijito ca, passi jahi upadhidukkhamūlaṃ, aparājito mārabalaṃ ajesi.

21591.notes: another base of pronoun ka. kiṃ, kissa, kisṃiṃ, kiṃhi, etc.

examples.text: kiṃ sundarikā karissati, kiṃ payāgo kiṃ bāhukā nadī, veriṃ katakibbisaṃ naraṃ, na hi naṃ sodhaye pāpakamminaṃ.
ky'āssa byappathayo assu, ky'āss'assu idha gocarā, kāni sīlabbatān'āssu, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno.
kikī'va aṇḍaṃ rakkheyya, cāmarī viya vāladhiṃ, nipako sīlasampanno, mamaṃ rakkhi mahāmuni.
kikī'va aṇḍaṃ, camarī'va vāladhiṃ, piyaṃ'va puttaṃ, nayanaṃ'va ekakaṃ, tath'eva sīlaṃ, anurakkhamānā.

21596.meaning1: name of the reigning king of Kāsi at the time of Kassapa Buddha
21596.meaning2: name of the reigning king at the time of Kassapa Buddha

examples.text: assosi kho, ānanda, kikī kāsirājā, kassapo kira bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bārāṇasiṃ anuppatto bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye'ti.

21597.meaning1: has any doubt about; has any uncertainty about
21597.commentary: (DNa) na tattha kiṃ kaṅkhati koci sāvako'ti kiṃ tattha tesu sāvakesu koci ekasāvako'pi buddh'ādīsu vā cātuddisabhāve vā na kaṅkhati sabbadisāsu asajjamāno agayhamāno viharatī'ti.

examples.text: etādisī dhammappakāsan'ettha, na tattha kiṅ'kaṅkhati koci sāvako, nitiṇṇa-oghaṃ vicikicchachinnaṃ, buddhaṃ namassāma jinaṃ jan'indaṃ.
dhammo, ānanda, pāsādo dvīhi kiṅkaṇikajālehi parikkhitto ahosi, ekaṃ jālaṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ ekaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ.

21599.meaning1: sound of a bell; tinkling of a bell
21599.commentary: (VINa) kiṅkaṇikasaddo'ti kiṅkaṇikajālassa saddo. yathā kira nānāratanehi katassa kiṅkaṇikajālassa saddo hoti, evaṃ tassā kuṭikāya vātapān'antarik'ādīhi paviṭṭhena vātena samāhatāya saddo ahosi. eten'assā anto ca bahi ca supakkabhāvo dassito hoti.
